summary: The case aims to kick a door, but its first JavaScript failure occurs earlier when ordinary movement attacks a monster. Ported uhitm.c:mhitm_knockback reaches its source unsolid(attacker) test and throws because js/uhitm.js omitted the existing mondata.js unsolid import. Restore that source predicate for every attack, then remeasure the case to find its next mismatch.

source.branch: mhitm_knockback checks attacker solidity after size, weapon, and living-monster guards, before testing hitflags or drawing knockback chance. The selected setup reaches this check during a hero attack before the intended door kick.
callers: uhitm.c:hmon_hitmon calls mhitm_knockback after a hero hit; js/uhitm.js:hmon_hitmon already calls the ported helper.
dependencies: mondata.c:unsolid is already ported as js/mondata.js:unsolid; import and use it at the existing source-mapped call site.
Re-evaluate the independent C recording after this general fix; its intended door action may reveal another source mismatch.

evidence: Saved v9 baseline challenges/evaluations/20260927170744-v9.json records ReferenceError "unsolid is not defined" with 0/9 screens for the immutable C recording.

Fresh scan at combined main 2e0a01a106aa02ff3ae520093dd4712eabe6fb6d traces the throw from js/uhitm.js:mhitm_knockback through hmon_hitmon and ordinary movement attack, before the case reaches a door kick.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/uhitm.c:mhitm_knockback around line 5327 calls unsolid(magr->data) to reject nonphysical attackers; js/uhitm.js uses unsolid in that function but its mondata.js import list omits the symbol.
